description.content: Auto Map Assignment allows devices to be automatically assigned to maps based on their location data. These API calls can be used to manage, apply, and clear auto map assignments for devices at the site level.

Apply (accept) auto map assignment results for a site. Devices are associated with their assigned maps. Omit `map_ids` or provide an empty list to accept all pending assignments; provide specific `map_ids` for a partial accept.
